_doc: GX3 / G1 pasture grass tiers (grass.cpp grassPreset; docs/ground-grass.md). density: clumps per m2 drawn within nearRadius (max 44). Beyond nearRadius the drawn share falls as (nearRadius / d)^falloff down to floor. cards: [near, mid, far] cards per clump of the coarse species (meadow, seed-head, straw, shrub, broadleaf, dune grass) at nearRadius / midRadius / radius; fineCards: the same for short turf and clover (max 12, each no more than the one before; the remaining cards widen to keep coverage). windRadius: vertex wind on clumps within it (0 = static; the Grass wind setting turns it off). shadowRadius: coarse clumps within it cast sun shadows (0 = none), fading out over its last 30 %; shadowCards: cards each caster draws into the sun map; shadowShare: the nested share of drawn coarse clumps that casts. Ultra (GrassQuality 4) is grass only: no graphics preset selects it. Read once at start-up.
